#1 signal prospect (202 pts). Cardinals land elite versatile defender who can play multiple positions.
Titans dominate Love signal at 48 pts - highest team signal score in dataset. Love led CFB in rushing TDs.
Giants top signal team for Styles (33 pts). Harbaugh builds defense-first; Styles tested like Calvin Johnson at combine.
Browns need OT; Freeling is a starter-ready blocker at value here.
Commanders top signal for Tate (18 pts). Elite receiver to stretch field for Daniels.
Saints address pass rush need. Bain is a disruptive interior/edge hybrid.
Chiefs bolster pass rush. Bailey is explosive off the edge.
Giants signal on Tyson (19 pts). Second pick from CIN trade gives Jaxson Dart an elite deep threat.
Dolphins top signal (25 pts); Mauigoa is elite OT who falls to Miami.
Cowboys add elite TE; Stowers has 99 signal pts and Cowboys need a red zone weapon.
Rams need CB. Delane is top cover corner in class.
Ravens top signal for Brazzell (30 pts). Major riser: 179 signal pts vs rank 41 consensus. Classic Ravens value pick.
Bucs top signal for Lemon; adds vertical speed opposite Evans and Godwin.
Lions add TE weapon for Goff. Sadiq is a mismatch creator.
Vikings need CB depth. McCoy fits zone scheme with elite athleticism.
Panthers build the OL. Proctor is a starter-ready tackle.
Steelers add safety. Thieneman is instinctive and rangy.
Chargers add interior pass rusher. Woods is a high-motor disruptor.
Eagles add receiver depth. Boston is a physical contested-catch specialist.
Bears give their QB another weapon. Cooper is an elite slot operator.
Bills add pass rush. Parker is a versatile edge with high motor.
49ers need LB. Hill is an elite run defender who fits Shanahan system.
Texans add pass rush opposite Will Anderson.
Patriots add versatile LB. Perkins is a chess piece for the defense.
Seahawks protect their QB. Lomu has a high ceiling as a developmental OT.
